name: connector.events.subscribe
title: Subscribe to Connector events
summary: Needed because a service worker is evicted between interactions: without retained replay, the Dashboard would show yesterday's Core state as current. The subscription is per-port, so it dies with the port and must be re-issued after reconnect.

maxPerSecond.description: Client-side rate limit for 'routing.decision' so a chatty sampled event cannot flood an evicted-and-restarted worker.

rejected.description: Names this build does not emit. Reported, not silently dropped, so an old Connector cannot make a new UI look inert.
